articles.summary: Union Pacific's intermodal team at Yard Center in Dolton, Illinois, recently held a food and winter clothing drive for the South Suburban Family Shelter in Homewood, Illinois.
articles.title: Illinois Seasonal Drive Benefits Victims of Domestic Violence

articles.summary: Columbus, Nebraska, seeks to honor Andrew Jackson Higgins, inventor of the LCVP, both at home and abroad -- all in time for the 70th anniversary of Victory in Europe Day.
articles.title: D-Day Memorial Honors Nebraska Inventor

articles.summary: Growing up as a volunteer firefighter, Union Pacific's Ben Salo learned why emergency responders are passionate about their work. Today he is part of a team that coaches fire departments across the country on how to prevent railroad disasters.
articles.title: Following His Calling to Train and Protect
